notes: Physical Media and Library use shared catalog refresh and manifest-reading paths; catalog refresh now updates both archive records and searchable manifest index.
Library scan, Check manifests and repair controls use a serialized background worker with progress, persisted status and explicit interrupted/failed results.

Safe repair preserves invalid JSON byte-for-byte as a uniquely named backup before rebuilding a manifest, and queues eligible stranded media through the verified Mover while leaving collisions for review.

Fixes health-scan route shadowing, supports audiobook root aliases and m4b during backfill, and preserves index entries while media roots are unavailable. Adds route, backup, stranded-repair, progress and unavailable-root regressions.
